section.name: Overview
section.p: For JavaScript bugs, please read Submitting JavaScript Bugs first.

In HtmlUnit, issues can stem from several causes: bugs in third-party libraries, unsupported browser functionality, issues within application code, or genuine bugs in HtmlUnit. We track issues using the GitHub issue tracking system at https://github.com/HtmlUnit/htmlunit/issues.

Before reporting an issue, verify that you are running the latest release version. If possible, test against the latest snapshot build or compile the latest source code to confirm whether the problem persists. Check project dependencies to ensure all required JAR files are present. Additionally, search open and recently closed issues to avoid submitting duplicates. If a matching issue exists, feel free to add relevant details or test cases to it.

section.name: How to Submit Reports That Get Responses
section.p: HtmlUnit development is a volunteer effort. Following these guidelines will help maintainers review and address your report faster:

ul.li: Describe the bug in detail. Maintainers must be able to reproduce the issue in order to fix it. Provide a minimal reproducible example containing only the essential Java code and HTML required to demonstrate the bug. Trimming unnecessary code drastically reduces investigation time.
Write a JUnit test case that reproduces the failure. Providing an automated test allows maintainers to reproduce and verify the issue immediately.
If you identify the root cause, submit a pull request with the fix alongside your unit test. Ensure contributions follow our guidelines for submitting pull requests.
